verdict.rationale: Letta ships a documented Agent SDK/API (TypeScript SDK, App Server with OpenAI-compatible API, ACP adapter, CLI headless mode for scripting/CI) enabling programmatic control, but the probe found no discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec, suggesting the public API surface isn't fully self-documented via standard machine-readable schema. missing for 10: a public OpenAPI/swagger spec or reference, independent hands-on confirmation of API usage beyond docs, and clearer completeness of REST endpoint documentation.
